channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on August 12, 2026 : US helicopter fires missiles at Panama-flagged ship attempting to evade blockade
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on August 12, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: US helicopter fires missiles at Panama-flagged ship attempting to evade blockade
item.description: US Central Command (CENTCOM) said a US Navy MH-60 helicopter fired two Hellfire missiles into the engine room of the M/V Vela Nova, disabling the vessel's steering gear and preventing it from continuing towards Iran.

item.title: Verity trailer: Dakota Johnson gets pulled into Anne Hathaway's dark world of secrets
item.description: The trailer for Verity, starring Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson, has sparked excitement among fans, who are praising its darker tone, casting and apparent faithfulness to Colleen Hoover’s bestselling psychological thriller.

item.title: Trump-Modi ‘good working relationship’ will fix Russian oil tariff issue? White House Adviser Navarro drops big hint
item.description: Navarro's comments came days after the US Senate passed legislation that could allow Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on goods from countries that continue buying Russian oil and gas.

item.title: Severe Storms Hit Chicago, Disrupt Hundreds of US Flights
item.description: Severe thunderstorms raked Chicago and the US Midwest on Tuesday, triggering tornado warnings and disrupting hundreds of flights.

item.title: US cancels 175,000+ visas — Here are the major reasons behind revocations
item.description: US Department of State said the actions were part of its ongoing vetting operations designed to ensure that visa holders comply with the conditions of their visas and do not pose a threat to Americans.

item.title: Is MSG safe? Food scientists bust common myths about the popular seasoning
item.description: Culinary experts are setting the record straight: MSG is not only safe but may also be the key to healthier, more flavourful meals.

item.title: Trump Accounts: Treasury allows employers to contribute up to $2,500 tax-free for employees' dependents
item.description: The new guidance provides a framework for employers that want to contribute directly to Trump Accounts for employees or their dependents. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the rules will allow employers to contribute up to $2,500 tax-free each year for employees' dependents.

item.title: 68% report high treatment costs, 56% flag costly ICU, room charges in private hospitals: Survey
item.description: Around 56% of respondents reported ‘excessively high charges of facilities like ICU and/or room’, while 51% said they were charged ‘excessively high prices of medicines and consumables.’

item.title: Bengaluru Zepto warehouse sealed in Hoskote; food safety dept imposes ₹25,000 fine
item.description: The FDA’s food safety division inspected the Hoskote facility to assess the quality and safety of food products, along with storage, labelling and handling practices.

item.title: Air India Phuket-Delhi pilot’s confirmatory drug test positive for banned substance: sources
item.description: The positive result follows a 300-foot mid-air plunge on an AI flight that injured 24 people, leaving the commander facing potential termination and regulatory sanctions.

item.title: West Bengal SIR: Supreme Court asks ECI for data on appeals against electoral roll deletions
item.description: Supreme Court directed the Election Commission of India to furnish details on appeals disposed of by tribunals hearing challenges to deletion of names from electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision exercise in West Bengal.&nbsp;

item.title: Colombia earthquake: 224 dead, 3,000+ missing, 1,600 buildings damaged; US and EU send aid — latest updates
item.description: Rescue workers, soldiers, volunteers and families continued digging through concrete rubble using cranes, excavators and their bare hands.

item.title: Net direct tax collections jump 23% to ₹8.11 trillion by 10 August
item.description: Net direct tax collections grew faster than gross receipts, led by non-corporate taxes and strong securities transaction tax collections.

item.title: Rajya Sabha passes Tribunals Reforms Bill
item.description: The bill proposes a National Tribunals Commission to fill vacancies, review performance and oversee complaints, while leaving NCLT outside its ambit.

item.title: Pakistan-Saudi-Turkey defence pact: India ‘examining implications’ on national security, says MEA
item.description: MEA stated that it is evaluating security and regional peace implications of the newly signed Mecca Defence Pact between Pakistan, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: TikTok to mandate 5-day office work for US employees from September: Report
item.description: In December, the company reportedly told employees in departments including product, marketing and advertising sales to prepare for a full return to the office in 2026.

item.title: Pan masala packaging gets stricter: FSSAI bans plastic, aluminium foil; permits paper, tin or glass
item.description: Under the revised rules, pan masala may be packed using paper, paperboard, cellulose and other naturally derived materials, provided they are entirely free of plastic.

item.title: Indian passport ranking: Govt rejects global ratings, says 27 countries offer visa-free entry
item.description: The Indian passport ranked 125th in the Global Passport Index 2026 as of 30 June.

item.title: India, Namibia identify critical minerals as key area for trade and investment push
item.description: The two nations agree to collaborate across the entire mining value chain during trade talks in New Delhi, while expanding ties in fintech, healthcare, and an upcoming Southern African trade deal.

item.title: Flight ticket prices: Why the government won’t cap domestic airfares despite festive-season surges
item.description: In response to concerns about dynamic airfare pricing, the Centre said it does not impose caps as airlines make these decisions based on the “forces of supply and demand”, It added that the DGCA monitors fares on specific routes to ensure compliance with declared tariffs.

item.title: Raw beef recall in US: Which products are affected, where was it sold and what should consumers do?
item.description: The affected beef was produced between May 15 and May 20, 2026, and carries use-or-freeze-by dates ranging from September 15 to September 20, 2026.

item.title: Kolkata: Security guard loses job after going viral for singing in video; social media erupts in anger, ‘Shame on us’
item.description: Shovan Chakraborty, a Kolkata security guard, lost his job after a viral video of him singing. Despite financial struggles, he seeks music students rather than charity.

item.title: India’s UNSC permanent seat push is a top priority, Government tells Lok Sabha
item.description: India says securing a permanent seat on an expanded UN Security Council remains a top priority, with New Delhi engaging all five permanent members.

item.title: Air India Phuket-Delhi pilot’s initial test results return positive for ‘marijuana’ a week after mishap: Report
item.description: The pilot-in-command tested positive for psychoactive substances during the post-flight screening in Delhi.

item.title: Dirty bomb threat? IAEA set to remove nuclear material from secret Syrian site after US-brokered deal: Report
item.description: The agreement concerns a secret facility known as “Site 99,” where material connected to the nuclear programme of former Syrian President Bashar al-Assad's government was reportedly stored.

item.title: Viral video: ‘Rapido driver’ approaches woman at night to offer ride; Instagram user shares, ‘What honestly shocked me…’
item.description: Siddhi shared a warning on Instagram after encountering a man falsely claiming to be a Rapido driver. She emphasised the importance of verifying drivers through official apps to ensure safety and urged women to be cautious of unverified approaches.

item.title: Diet Coke as election symbol? Arvind Kejriwal’s Gen Z moment has the internet in splits
item.description: This comes amid the BJP also sharpening its digital outreach to the young people following the recent NEET-UG paper leak controversy.

item.title: Who is Atef Najib, the ex-Syrian security official sentenced to death with Bashar al-Assad?
item.description: Najib is a former Syrian army brigadier general who headed the Political Security Branch in Daraa, in southern Syria, in 2011. He is also a maternal cousin of Bashar al-Assad.

item.title: IMD flags flood risk as heavy rain to continue across India
item.description: Rainfall likely to remain widespread across central, eastern and northeastern India through 17 August, with very heavy rain forecast in parts of Rajasthan, Odisha and the Western Himalayas

item.title: Indian man shares how he went from 37K per month to ₹2.2 crore+ package: 'Feels like a flex'
item.description: In 2019, he moved to a FAANG-level company and secured a ₹44 lakh annual package, which he described as a three-fold increase over his previous compensation.

item.title: No relief for Mamata Banerjee: Supreme Court refuses to release ₹440 crore from TMC’s frozen bank accounts
item.description: The Supreme Court has denied relief to Mamata Banerjee's TMC regarding frozen bank accounts totalling ₹440 crore, maintaining a Calcutta High Court order.&nbsp;

item.title: Dhruv Rathee's YouTube video on Hindu deities withheld in India, not globally: Google tells Delhi HC
item.description: The Centre said that once a video has been objected to, then the order must apply across the board. “Otherwise the baton will be passed from a to b, then b to c, and c to d….”

item.title: Applying for a job at Google? DeepMind staff warns its AI hiring filters may screen out your CV ‘incorrectly’
item.description: A Google DeepMind spokesperson said the company’s objective is to ‘recruit and hire the most qualified talent at Google DeepMind’ and rejected the suggestion that its systems incorrectly filter out candidates.

item.title: Delhi HC calls for sanity in personality-rights cases, says free speech under threat
item.description: Hearing actor Janhvi Kapoor’s plea to block over 6,000 URLs, the court refused blanket injunctions, ruling that takedowns will apply only to obscenity or direct commercial misuse to safeguard free expression.
